descriptor: Rehearsal desk for stage lighting sequences

voice.summary: Sounds like a stage manager calling cues: terse, ordered and calm. Numbers and times are the language, adjectives are rare.
dos: Number every cue and name it in two words
Give levels and fade times in figures
donts: No guessing at levels, always show the number

taglines: Cue by cue, fade by fade
A small rehearsal for big light
boilerplate: Loomlight is a rehearsal desk for stage lighting, letting designers arrange three-channel cues, set levels and run timed crossfades before they ever touch a rig.

microcopy.error: Fade could not run, check the cue levels
microcopy.empty: No cues in this sequence yet

logo.note: A bolt of light reflects stage power and a fast crossfade.
